title: How to Write in 3rd Person Limited POV
skills: identify third-person limited point of view
write consistently from a limited perspective
control reader access to a character's thoughts and experiences
analyze how limited narration shapes suspense and interpretation
alignment_note: Explains how third-person limited point of view restricts narration to the perspective and knowledge of a particular character. Supports point-of-view analysis, narrative control, character perspective, suspense, and creative writing across high school English courses.
